dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: I am Elzer. Under his grace, when the master of the house is away, I take care of most major affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Master Diluc... Does not tend to worry himself too much with the affairs of the winery.

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: So, whatever business you are here to discuss, is probably best discussed with me directly.

choices.text: You have another identity, don't you?

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: My, you have a keen eye for detail.

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: It is true that my other role is Chief Executive of the Mondstadt Wine Appreciation Guild.

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: But I do not do it for appearances, nor do I seek to hide it, my liege.

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: The simple fact is that given Dawn Winery's standing in Mondstadt...

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: There is barely any distinction to be made between managing the affairs of the winery and managing the affairs of the whole industry.

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: My past? That's something I can talk freely about.

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: I trust you know of the winery's former owner, Master Crepus? He was Diluc's father.

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: Master Crepus was like a father to me, too.

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: He was in the prime of his life at the time of his tragic accident all those years ago...

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: Master Diluc spent a long time grieving. It was during that time that I started taking care of some of the winery's affairs.

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: I thought that rather than be overcome by sorrow, it was better for me to share some of Master Diluc's load. It was also the only thing I could do.

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: Though it was a little presumptuous of me to act beyond my role, I do think perhaps that's what Master Crepus would have liked to see.

response.speaker: Elzer
response.text: *sigh* Sorry, that got a bit deep and depressing, didn't it.
